text:
hannah_support: FYI - VertexGrid reported an unexpected dedicated overage on 08/12. They have a 7-node reserved commit but the bill shows ~14 node-hours charged as burst across two short windows. Can ops/finance triage?

sam_fin: Please paste invoice lines and the pool id so I can start a reconciliation.

hannah_support: INV-2026-0812 in ticket VG-2244. Pool id: vg-res-7. Billing snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0812
Period: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31
 - Reserved capacity (vg-res-7): 7 nodes - $14,000
 - Burst usage (burst-unallocated): 14 node-hours - $210
Total: $14,210
```

metering-bot: Meter export attached: vg_meter_2026_08_12.csv (see ticket).

diego_ops: Quick look: region us-central had a brief routing split during a config rollout where the aggregator saw two simultaneous meter streams for the same nodes. Our merge window logic treats overlapping streams as potential duplicates and, to be conservative, attributes the second stream to burst if owner metadata isn't stable. The owner metadata from the aggregator lagged by ~6 minutes.

sam_fin: Can you export node-level rows for the windows with seen_owner, ts, meter_id? Need to validate re-association. Also estimate the dollar delta if we backfill.

diego_ops: Export attached (vg_overlap_08_12.csv). Summary: 14 node-hours safe to re-associate -> estimated invoice delta $210. We'll run a targeted backfill restricted to the 08/12 windows. Backfill id bf-2026-990 scheduled. Patch to the merge logic queued so future short stream overlaps use owner precedence when org_id matches.

tara_sales: VertexGrid is renewing next quarter; sales prefers we issue the invoice adjustment and offer a small relationship credit since they noticed slight tail latency during the overlap. Propose invoice adj $210 + service credit $500 = $710 total.

sam_fin: Manager-level approval covers it. I'll approve up to $2,500. Create two credit memos: CM-2026-701 (INV adj $210, reason: STREAM_MERGE_LAG) and CM-2026-702 (Service credit $500, reason: GOODWILL_LATENCY). Routing to AP for posting to August ledger.

lina_revops: Revops ticket revops-981 created; attaching vg_overlap_08_12.csv and backfill bf-2026-990 for audit.

diego_ops: Backfill completed; rows re-associated to vg-res-7. Merge-logic patch deployed to canary.

hannah_support: Draft to customer: "We found a brief metering stream overlap during a config rollout that caused 14 node-hours to be billed as burst. We've corrected the records (invoice adjustment $210) and applied a $500 service credit for the observed latency. Patch deployed to reduce recurrence; credits should appear within 48h." Will send after AP confirms posting.

sam_fin: AP posted CM-2026-701 and CM-2026-702 to the August ledger. Finance closing ticket. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
